absoluteDifficulty.audienceGround: The question asks recognition of a named Russian/Soviet economic policy among four real Soviet policy labels. Adults familiar with Russian history are likely to recognize NEP; outsiders may use the date to narrow the list but still need the specific policy association. No specialist knowledge or multi-step logic is required.
absoluteDifficulty.judgment: Frozen MEDIUM remains plausible. Time contrast makes it easier for adults with school-history knowledge; no audience measurements were supplied, so this is editorial judgment, not empirical calibration.
